messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
After the breathing treatment and EKG was done, I moved back into a wheelchair and head off to get some x-rays of my chest done.

output.original_text: After the breathing treatment and EKG was done, I moved back into a wheelchair and head off to get some x-rays of my chest done.
output.joy: After the breathing treatment and EKG was done, I happily moved back into a wheelchair and set off to get some x-rays of my chest done!
output.sadness: After the breathing treatment and EKG was done, I reluctantly moved back into a wheelchair and made my way to get some x-rays of my chest done.
output.fear: After the breathing treatment and EKG was over, I cautiously moved back into a wheelchair, anxious as I headed off to get some x-rays of my chest done.
output.anger: After the breathing treatment and EKG—finally done—I shoved myself back into a wheelchair and stormed off to get some x-rays of my chest done.
output.surprise: After the breathing treatment and EKG was done, I unexpectedly found myself back in a wheelchair, heading off to get some x-rays of my chest done.
output.disgust: After the breathing treatment and EKG was done, I grimaced as I moved back into a wheelchair to get some x-rays of my chest done.
